source.description:
## What implementation this covers

Covers implementation issue xtrm-9xg2.2 (CI + pack guards for flat active layout).

## Layer classification

Boundary layer. This work validates filesystem/package/CI contracts at repo → packed artifact seam and at source-tree scan boundary.

## Strategy chosen

Contract tests and smoke checks, live-first within local CI:
- inspect real `npm pack` file list
- run real source scan script against tracked files
- assert approved ignore/transient paths are only exceptions

## Test file structure

Prefer one focused test surface plus one CI invocation:
- script-level test under existing CLI/workflow test area if helper is scripted
- workflow smoke step in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
- fixtures for allowlisted historical/transient paths if needed

## What to assert

- Packed tarball does not contain `.xtrm/skills/active/**`.
- Guard fails on synthetic `active/claude` / `active/pi` references outside allowlist.
- Guard passes for explicitly declared transient/historical paths only.
- Guard output mentions canonical `.xtrm/skills/active` / `.xtrm/hooks/` contract.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Boundary contract checks cover real pack output, not mocked file lists.
- [ ] Source-scan regression case proves stale runtime-tier paths fail CI.
- [ ] Allowlist behavior is asserted with concrete fixtures/examples.
- [ ] Test docs/name reference xtrm-9xg2.2 and updated canonical layout.
source.title: Test: flat active layout CI guard and packed artifact contract
